scope: Editing after prepared completion insertion at document end
actions: delete entire completed token character by character
delete last character, type x, commit with space
result: All expected text preserved including preceding prose; no phantom deletion or replacement in these cases.
limits: Production InputCoordinator and language packs with FakeDocument; starts at completion insertion, does not model prefix deletion or UIKit.
Not native undo; backspace actions only.
Does not invalidate earlier middle-cursor duplication, selection or lost-touch-evidence findings.
